assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only re-zero:otto-suwen@light-novel#character-model, the canonical derived-use model REZERO_OTTO_SUWEN_V01_V13_CHARACTER_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the original Japanese main light novels V01-V13, whose material Otto evidence begins in V05 and is drawn from V05, V06 and V09-V13. The project's CURRENT_STATE_AND_CORPUS_MAP.md and 05 Character Analysis README were read for method, authority order and scope only. The separate scoped fidelity review, the frozen volume readings, the master and five owner ledgers, the reconstruction protocol, the source lock and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's MONOGRAPH_READY and PASS_WITH_BOUND labels and its HIGH and MEDIUM confidence tags are inputs, not conclusions. No V14 or later volume, separately admitted IF, web-novel, supplement or adaptation material is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Otto's selectors from the retrospectively narrated childhood, filtering and adolescent flight (O0-O2, narrated in V13), the four-year traveling merchant (O3), the pre-Sanctuary acquaintance of V09-V10 and RZ-E-013 (O4), the discarded E015 friend and rescuer (O5) and E017 listener (O6), to the E018 phases before the dawn confrontation (O7a), the accepted partial brief and coauthored wager (O7b), the independent delay battle (O7c) and the default O7d: living E018 outside the tomb while Emilia begins her renewed first trial, having helped delay Garfiel and returned carrying Ram, with real bodily cost. The V05 and V06 encounters, E015 and E017 are different counterparts whose experience the default Otto does not remember. The declared horizon is V13; the two-site rescue, wager, mansion and trial outcomes and anything in V14-V17, which the project has since admitted, are expressly not established. No in-world calendar dates are fixed beyond his narrated age of twenty and four years of trade.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Section 1's governing interpretation (wanting an intelligible, viable place with others without reducing it to a price, with self-imposed debt, commerce, fear and chosen friendship coexisting), twenty-six conditional rules with exceptions and confidence, section 4's motive and attention analysis and section 11's six rejected rival readings with revision discriminators form a rule-level inferential structure on thirty-two located bundles. Counterweights: a single same-analyst artifact; much of the behavioral variety comes from discarded counterparts in different information states; the model states that no universal priority ranking among commerce, family debt and friendship is demonstrated.

Section 2.1 names eleven selection slices with within-phase gates (O7a-O7d forbid inserting the briefing, wager or Ram cooperation before they occur), and section 2.2 separates Otto's own remembered history (childhood, cult rescue, E013 travel) from Subaru-only E015 and E017 counterparts. The childhood is a single retrospective V13 inset, V07-V08 supply no Otto evidence, the V05 and V06 counterparts are not his remembered past, and the horizon ends at V13 while the project spine is V17.

Section 9 records twelve located features with loci: 僕 with ナツキさん across commercial, angry and caring contexts, the E018 full-name rebuke, エミリア様 against パトラッシュちゃん, comic interrogative protest, チクショウ and 僕ぁ showing register variation predates the friendship, guarded bargaining phrasing, the unordered-hearing offer, explicit risk and fear language, the E015 friend-word struggle and nonhuman vocal adjustment. It instructs choosing purpose, knowledge and audience before address and returns JAPANESE_REGISTER_SAMPLE_TOO_NARROW for fine-grained requests; no frequency data or complete phonetic profile exists.

Section 6 gives thirteen ordinary and occupational domains with bundle loci: cargo, pricing and records, driving and routes, cart and travel medicine, habitual merchant cleanliness, a specific missed-meal protest, V05 despair-drinking, reading by portable light, family, Fulfhu, humor, crying and privacy, and low-stakes repair. This is denser than most model subjects but largely occupational; favorite food and drink, hobbies, music, solitary leisure and a complete ordinary day are ORDINARY_LIFE_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT, and section 6 forbids filling the day with attractive invented routines.

Section 7 conditions conduct across twelve recipient rows (Subaru, Emilia, Ram, Garfiel, Roswaal, Fulfhu, Patrasche, Ricardo, Mimi and the mercenaries, the elder brother, parents and younger brother, other creatures and clients), each with its own remembered history and nontransfer, and section 7.1 gives four matched-recipient contrasts labeled as bounded inference rather than observed paired experiments. Otto-side only; Emilia and Roswaal rest on few scenes, family relations are retrospective only and their present lives are unshown.

The strongest interior evidence is the V13 focal life inset (B23-B28): childhood voices, the brother's written channel, self-imposed repayment, the Ricardo relief and the insight that helping Subaru also helps his earlier misunderstood self, which the model labels HIGH on focal motive and MEDIUM on transfer. Outside that one chapter interiority is inferred from speech and action (B20's waiting denial, B22's voiced fear), the Ram condition's content is withheld from the reader, and the model forbids treating focal narration as a spoken confession.

Rules R03, R05-R07, R09, R16 and R19-R22 cover the adolescent counter-accusation and its violent reply, bargaining under pressure, the paid-transport danger refusal, the E010 ejection under terror, reckless shortcuts, the E018 confrontation that begins with his punch, and the prepared delay battle against Garfiel with its sensory cost and the insufficient Al Dona, each with adverse or failure cases located (B05, B10, B22, B30). Conflict after V13 and any rematch are outside the set.

Moral positions are located in action and speech: refusing safe paid silence (B16), insisting on the named friendship against a purchase or safety account (B17, R26), keeping Ram's confidence when Subaru asks (R22), self-imposed repayment that the model refuses to turn into a duty to earn existence by dying (B26-B28, R23), and the E010 ejection, explained but not excused (B05). The model supplies no general deliberation procedure and leaves the priority between commerce, debt and friendship unresolved.

Comic interrogative protests, surname banter, the mock-confession retort, the unfinished-consolation complaint and embarrassed counterattacks are located (B01, B06, B13, B17, B20, B22) and rule R13 with section 4.3 governs them, forbidding the conversion of every comic protest into secret consent. No humor inventory or matched contrast exists and the instances are mostly reactive.

Section 14 fixes seven locked Japanese witnesses (V05, V06, V09-V13) by SHA-256; V13 was completely consumed before construction and targeted Japanese checks reverified the specified older cases, explicitly not a new full rereading of V01-V13. V01-V04, V07 and V08 supply no Otto scene, the childhood is a single inset, and the declared V13 horizon is four volumes behind the project's admitted V17 and excludes the separate review.

Fourteen negative controls, six rejected rival readings with revision discriminators and located countercases bind the model: the E010 ejection under an unverified bait explanation (B05), the oil and iron failure and admitted deception (B01, B25), the promise-qualification tension (B08), reckless shortcuts (B10), animals that may deceive or give unusable routes (B18), the insufficient borrowed-mana spell and real sensory cost (B30), and the punch that is not consent (NC13). All sit inside one artifact with the project's own review.

Phases are bound to RZ-E-008, RZ-E-010, RZ-E-013, E015, E017 and the four E018 sub-phases with explicit ordering gates; section 2.2 tables what each history means for the default Otto and for Subaru, NC01-NC02 separate Subaru-only memories from Otto's own rescue debt, and the default is a reached living coordinate rather than an accomplished rescue. The single retrospective childhood inset, the V07-V08 gap and the four-volume lag to the V17 spine bound it.

conditions: Written Japanese register only, as section 9 defines it; no anime performance, measured acoustics or transcribed animal vocabulary.
Purpose, knowledge, audience and recipient are selected before address: ナツキさん as the recurring default, the full-name rebuke only in its E018 situation, エミリア様 and パトラッシュちゃん for their recipients.

No elaborate confession is generated where the evidence supports only a practical question or a refusal to disclose, fear is not deleted to make a promise grander, and constant comic shouting is not a fidelity target.
The V13 focal inset is never placed in his mouth as an already delivered disclosure.
Output is noncanonical reconstruction output and is never cited as evidence.
scenario_readiness.note: The forms are located and recipient-conditioned and register variation is attested before the friendship, but the sample is small; the model generates no canon dialogue.

conditions: Chronology is one named selector, by default O7d, living E018 outside the tomb; no V14 or later, IF, web-novel or adaptation state is used, and the horizon is stated.

Knowledge is limited to section 8: no RBD or Witch-tea disclosure, no remembered E015 or E010 counterpart experience unless that discarded state is explicitly selected, no Roswaal confession or full Puck interview, and no invented content for Ram's private condition, which he keeps confidential.

The interlocutor is an attested recipient in an attested relation; an unknown client does not inherit the friend's trust or his willingness to hear an unordered account, and creatures are not political informants.
Commerce, debt and friendship are recorded as competing priorities rather than resolved by a fixed winner, and danger is not escalated until self-sacrifice proves sincerity.
No readiness is inherited from the model's MONOGRAPH_READY or PASS_WITH_BOUND labels.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named Otto selector, by default O7d, living E018 outside the tomb while Emilia begins her renewed first trial, after the delay battle and his return carrying Ram; the O0-O4 history and the discarded V05, V06, E015 and E017 counterparts only when explicitly selected with their own knowledge, remembered history, recipient, role and resources.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Subaru, Emilia, Ram, Garfiel, Roswaal, Fulfhu, Patrasche, Ricardo, Mimi and the mercenaries, family members in the retrospective phases, other creatures or ordinary clients, each as a distinct person or creature in its attested relation; strangers only with reasonable terms and evidence, without inherited trust.
setting_constraints: Trade routes, markets and the Mathers camp, the Sanctuary and tomb, and travel by dragon carriage as narrated
No crossover institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the V01-V13 corpus

The language blessing follows the demonstrated conditions: local informants with relevant perspective, possible deception, filtering and real cost under prolonged full use; no mind control, rock consciousness, exact translation or infinite mana
ORDINARY_LIFE_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT, KNOWLEDGE_STATE_UNKNOWN, MECHANICS_CAUSATION_OPEN, INTERNAL_MOTIVE_UNDERDETERMINED and ENDPOINT_NOT_YET_READ end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: Section 13 supplies nine noncanonical probes with selectors, matched contrasts and refusals, but they were assessed only by the same analyst's nonblind documentary review, which lies outside this evidence set.

conditions: Scenes of attested kinds only: trade talk and terms, records, driving and route choice, a missed meal or neglected attention, low-stakes slights and prompt apologies, public teasing and private tears, and care for Fulfhu or Patrasche.
Favorite food and drink, hobbies, music, a daily schedule and present family life end in abstention; V05 despair-drinking is contextual, not a preference or a habit.
Comic protest is a real objection as well as a joke, and one accepted apology does not license later neglect.
scenario_readiness.note: Section 6 supports a denser ordinary baseline than most model subjects, mostly occupational, with explicit unknowns.

conditions: Only the attested classes: paid safety versus a friend's danger, purchase or profit accounts of help, confidentiality of an ally's condition, self-imposed repayment and debt, and danger limits in paid work.
The E010 ejection remains harmful and is not excused or prescribed, and debt never becomes an obligation to earn existence by dying.
A dilemma the source does not stage ends in abstention.
scenario_readiness.note: Positions are located in several scenes, but the model supplies no general procedure and leaves his priority ranking unresolved.

NC11 and section 12 mark care, debt, tears, teasing, carrying and a dragon's interpreted concern as ROMANTIC_INTERPRETATION_NOT_TEXTUALLY_RESOLVED, and the model supplies no romance. Located constraints exist, so the scenario is assessed and found unsupported rather than unassessed.

conditions: Attested roles only: traveling merchant with cart and dragon, paid inventory worker, driver and route-finder, and voluntary ally; not a formally appointed permanent camp official.
Payment, audience, compensation and cart repair remain pending; an accepted backup task, nickname or friendship is not employment or all-risk assent.
Competence is domain-specific: inventory is not magic, language access is not successful negotiation, route knowledge is not safety, and the blessing has real cost.
scenario_readiness.note: Merchant work, driving and the language blessing are the best-evidenced domain, with section 6 separating competence from failure and resources.

known_limits.statement: The model declares its horizon as V01-V13 and its default as living E018 outside the tomb with the two-site rescue, wager, mansion occupants and Emilia's trial unresolved, and returns ENDPOINT_NOT_YET_READ for later outcomes; the project's admitted spine has since reached V17, so the default is the end of this evidence set, four volumes before the continuity's latest admitted state.

The model records its fidelity state as a scoped nineteen-dimension PASS_WITH_BOUND that is same-analyst and nonblind, not a separate runtime, independent benchmark or global capability tier, subject to its own full publication gate, and sets do_not_use_as_primary_literary_authority to true as a derived-use artifact subordinate to the source lock, frozen readings and owner ledgers.

The V05 sympathy and refusal, the V06 ejection, the E015 friendship, rescue and death and the E017 offered hearing are different counterparts whose experience the default Otto does not remember; they are evidence of conduct under their own coordinates, not his autobiography, while his own cult rescue, childhood and E013 travel are his remembered history.

Otto receives no RBD or Witch-tea disclosure, no Roswaal confession or full Puck interview, and no miasma detection; he knows the content of Ram's private cooperation condition, which the admitted text withholds from the reader, so the model represents the confidence without inventing its content or making him ignorant of it.

Childhood, family, adolescent flight and the helping-his-earlier-self motive come from one retrospective V13 focal inset; the relatives' present lives, names and current contact are unshown, the written-language accommodation is not a clinical diagnosis, and Subaru receives only fragments of it.

The separate fidelity review, the frozen readings, the ledgers, the protocol and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated on this subject, and the project's later admitted V14-V17 lie outside this set; none was used, and missing support is not evidence of absence.
